metadata.title: AWS What’s Next Ft.  Amazon Textract for Handwriting
metadata.author: Amazon Web Services
metadata.shortDescription:
Sonali Sahu, Solutions Architect, AWS demonstrates Amazon Textract is a fully managed machine learning service that automatically extracts printed text, handwriting, and other data from scanned documents that goes beyond simple optical character recognition (OCR) to identify, understand, and extract data from forms and tables. 
For more information, check out Textract’s product page at https://amzn.to/3eRKUIU 

Want to tune in live for the next episode? 
You can find dates and more information about our upcoming streams at - https://amzn.to/35KUHOe 
Watch past AWS What’s Next episodes at - http://bit.ly/2O3zS75

Subscribe: 
More AWS videos http://bit.ly/2O3zS75 
More AWS events videos http://bit.ly/316g9t4
